categories.main_business_segments: Avary Holding primarily operates in the printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing industry, focusing on the research, design, production, sales, and service of various PCB products. Its product lines include communication boards, consumer electronics and computer boards, automotive/server boards, and other specialized boards. The company serves sectors such as smartphones, network equipment, tablets, wearables, laptops, servers, automotive electronics, and AI data centers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including flexible printed circuits (FPC), surface mount assembly (SMA), substrate-like PCB (SLP), high-density interconnect (HDI), Mini LED, rigid PCBs, and rigid-flex boards. It utilizes cutting-edge processes such as cavity technology, laser drilling for microvias, multi-layer HDI, and embedded components. The firm emphasizes innovation in materials, processes, and equipment, with a strong focus on AI, 6G communications, automotive electronics, and high-speed data transmission technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Avary Holding's key customers are leading global electronics brands and electronic manufacturing service providers, primarily in the communication electronics, consumer electronics, computer, automotive, and AI server markets. The company maintains long-term partnerships with top-tier clients in smartphones, AI devices, automotive Tier 1 suppliers, and data center equipment manufacturers. Its products support end markets including mobile communications, AI-enabled consumer devices, electric and smart vehicles, and cloud computing infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant sales concentrated in the United States (over 80% of revenue), Greater China, and other Asian countries including Thailand, India, Japan, and Singapore. It has manufacturing and R&D facilities in China (Shenzhen, Huai'an, Qinhuangdao), Taiwan, Thailand, India, Japan, and Singapore, supporting a global supply chain and customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: Avary Holding operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of printed circuit boards. It provides customized PCB solutions and services directly to OEMs and EMS providers, integrating R&D, design, manufacturing, and sales. The company also engages in upstream activities such as material procurement and downstream activities including technical support and after-sales service, positioning itself as a comprehensive PCB solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on technological leadership in high-end PCB products, especially targeting AI cloud, management, and endpoint applications, as well as automotive electronics. It invests heavily in R&D to develop advanced PCB technologies like high-frequency, high-density, embedded components, and new materials. Digital transformation, AI integration in manufacturing, and green low-carbon initiatives are key priorities. The firm also pursues global capacity expansion and deepens collaboration with leading customers for co-development and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Avary Holding generates revenue primarily through the sale of customized printed circuit boards and related services. It operates on a build-to-order production model with direct sales to global brand customers. Revenue streams include product sales across communication, consumer electronics, automotive, and server segments. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income, but these constitute a minor portion of total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Avary Holding is a global leader in the PCB industry, ranked as the largest PCB manufacturer worldwide by revenue for eight consecutive years. It competes with other top PCB producers but maintains a dominant market position due to its comprehensive product portfolio, technological capabilities, and strong customer relationships. The company benefits from industry consolidation trends favoring large-scale, technologically advanced manufacturers with robust capital and innovation resources.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Avary Holding achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 35.14 billion, representing a 9.59% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.62 billion, up 10.14%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 44.54 billion, with steady growth in net assets and strong cash flow generation. It maintains a healthy financial structure with an asset-liability ratio of 27.44% and continues to invest significantly in R&D and capacity expansion to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Avary Holding offers a one-stop, full-spectrum PCB product and service platform with a diverse and high-quality product range tailored to meet the evolving needs of leading global electronics customers. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, rapid order response, high-volume supply capacity, and stringent quality assurance. The company emphasizes innovation in advanced PCB technologies, digital and green manufacturing, and deep integration with customer value chains to deliver superior, customized solutions that accelerate customers’ time-to-market and market competitiveness.
